title: On a spectral space a finitely presented sheaf of sets embeds into a finite product of pushed-forward finite constant sheaves on constructible closed subsets
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ and a set $S$ let $j_{U!}\underline S$ be the extension by the empty set [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty] of the sheaf $\underline S_U$ of locally constant maps to $S$ on $U$; for a closed $Z\subseteq X$ with inclusion $i_Z$ and a set $R$ let $(i_Z)_*\underline R_Z$ be the sheaf of sets $V\mapsto\{$locally constant maps $V\cap Z\to R\}$ ($V\subseteq X$ open, restriction of maps). Let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X$ for which there are integers $m,n\ge0$, quasi-compact open subsets $U_1,\dots,U_n,V_1,\dots,V_m\subseteq X$, finite sets $S_1,\dots,S_n,T_1,\dots,T_m$, two morphisms $\beta,\gamma:\coprod_{b=1}^mj_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to\coprod_{a=1}^nj_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ and a morphism $q:\coprod_{a=1}^nj_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}\to\mathcal F$ such that $(\mathcal F,q)$ is a coequalizer of $\beta,\gamma$, coproducts and coequalizer taken in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then there are $k\ge0$, constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] closed subsets $Z_1,\dots,Z_k\subseteq X$, finite sets $R_1,\dots,R_k$ and a morphism of sheaves $\mathcal F\to\prod_{l=1}^k(i_{Z_l})_*\underline{R_l}_{Z_l}$ (product computed sectionwise) which is injective on sections over every open subset of $X$.

source.place: Modules, Section 'Constructible sheaves of sets' (Tag 0CAG): Lemma Tag 0CAL (label lemma-constructible-in-constant, line 3133), whose proof reduces by Lemma Tag 0CAK (label lemma-constructible-comes-from-finite, line 3061) to a finite sober space and omits two details (the end of the proof of 0CAK, and that i_{x,*}F_x is constant on the closure of x)

proof.text: *Step 1 (reduction to a finite sober space; Tag 0CAK).* The sheaf $\mathcal F$ on the spectral space $X$, with the data $U_a,V_b,S_a,T_b,\beta,\gamma,q$ of the statement, satisfies exactly the hypothesis of [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-finite-coequalizer-from-finite-space]. It gives a finite sober topological space $Y$, a continuous map $f:X\to Y$ with $f^{-1}(V)$ quasi-compact for every open $V\subseteq Y$, a sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $Y$ all of whose stalks $\mathcal G_y$ are finite, and an isomorphism of sheaves of sets $\psi:f^{-1}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal F$, $f^{-1}$ the inverse image of sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image].

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAL (label lemma-constructible-in-constant, line 3133), first sentence: 'By Lemma 0CAK we reduce to the case of a finite sober topological space and a sheaf with finite stalks'; Lemma Tag 0CAK (label lemma-constructible-comes-from-finite, line 3061)

proof.text: *Step 2 (on $Y$: $\mathcal G\subseteq\prod_yi_{y,*}\mathcal G_y$).* For $y\in Y$ let $i_{y,*}\mathcal G_y$ be the skyscraper sheaf at $y$ with value $\mathcal G_y$ ($V\mapsto\mathcal G_y$ if $y\in V$, $V\mapsto\{*\}$ if $y\notin V$, as in [lem-weil-pbc-skyscraper-constant-on-point-closure]). Since $Y$ is finite, $\mathcal P^0=\prod_{y\in Y}i_{y,*}\mathcal G_y$, computed sectionwise, is a sheaf of sets and a product in the category of sheaves of sets [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaf-sets-limits-sectionwise]. For $V\subseteq Y$ open define $e^0_V:\mathcal G(V)\to\mathcal P^0(V)$ by $e^0_V(s)=(s_y)_{y\in Y}$, where the $y$-component is the germ $s_y\in\mathcal G_y$ if $y\in V$ and $*$ if $y\notin V$. For opens $V'\subseteq V$ and $y\in V'$ one has $(s|_{V'})_y=s_y$, so the $e^0_V$ commute with the restriction maps and form a morphism of sheaves $e^0:\mathcal G\to\mathcal P^0$. It is injective on sections over every open $V$: if $e^0_V(s)=e^0_V(t)$ then $s_y=t_y$ for every $y\in V$, hence $s=t$ by [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-sections-determined-by-germs].

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAL (label lemma-constructible-in-constant, line 3133): 'In this case F is contained in prod_{x in X} i_{x,*}F_x where i_x : {x} -> X is the embedding'; Sheaves, Lemma Tag 0079 (lemma-sheaf-subset-stalks); skyscraper sheaves Sheaves, Definition Tag 009A

proof.text: *Step 3 (the skyscraper sheaves are constant on closures; the first omitted detail of 0CAL).* For $y\in Y$ put $W_y=\overline{\{y\}}$, a closed subset of $Y$, and $R_y=\mathcal G_y$, a finite set by Step 1. By [lem-weil-pbc-skyscraper-constant-on-point-closure] (applied to $Y$, $y$ and $A=R_y$) there is an isomorphism of sheaves of sets $\kappa^y:i_{y,*}R_y\xrightarrow{\sim}(i_{W_y})_*\underline{R_y}_{W_y}$, where $(i_{W_y})_*\underline{R_y}_{W_y}(V)=\{$locally constant maps $V\cap W_y\to R_y\}$. Put $\mathcal A_y=(i_{W_y})_*\underline{R_y}_{W_y}$ and $\mathcal P=\prod_{y\in Y}\mathcal A_y$ (sectionwise). The product $\prod_y\kappa^y:\mathcal P^0\to\mathcal P$ is bijective on sections over every open, so $e=(\prod_y\kappa^y)\circ e^0:\mathcal G\to\mathcal P$ is a morphism of sheaves of sets on $Y$ injective on sections over every open (explicitly the $y$-component of $e_V(s)$ is the constant map with value $s_y$ on $V\cap W_y$ if $y\in V$, and the empty map if $y\notin V$).

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAL (label lemma-constructible-in-constant, line 3133): 'We omit the proof that i_{x,*}F_x is a constant sheaf on the closure of x'

proof.text: *Step 4 ($f^{-1}$ preserves injectivity on sections).* Let $\varphi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a morphism of sheaves of sets on $Y$ injective on sections over every open; we show that $f^{-1}\varphi$ is injective on sections over every open of $X$. (a) $\varphi$ is injective on stalks: if $a,a'\in\mathcal A(V)$ (two germs at $y$ can be represented on a common open $V\ni y$) and $\varphi_y(a_y)=\varphi_y(a'_y)$, then $\varphi_V(a)|_O=\varphi_V(a')|_O$ for some open $y\in O\subseteq V$, i.e. $\varphi_O(a|_O)=\varphi_O(a'|_O)$, so $a|_O=a'|_O$ and $a_y=a'_y$. (b) Let $x\in X$, $y=f(x)$, and let $c_{\mathcal A}:\mathcal A_y\to(f^{-1}\mathcal A)_x$, $c_{\mathcal B}:\mathcal B_y\to(f^{-1}\mathcal B)_x$ be the bijections of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-inverse-image-stalk], characterized by $c_{\mathcal A}(a_y)=(\eta_{\mathcal A,V}(a))_x$ for $a\in\mathcal A(V)$, $V\ni y$ open, $\eta$ the unit of $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (3). The unit is natural: $(f^{-1}\varphi)_{f^{-1}V}\circ\eta_{\mathcal A,V}=\eta_{\mathcal B,V}\circ\varphi_V$ (it is $f_*\theta\circ i$ with $\theta$ and $i$ natural, [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), (3)). Hence $(f^{-1}\varphi)_x(c_{\mathcal A}(a_y))=((f^{-1}\varphi)(\eta_{\mathcal A,V}(a)))_x=(\eta_{\mathcal B,V}(\varphi_V(a)))_x=c_{\mathcal B}(\varphi_y(a_y))$, so $(f^{-1}\varphi)_x\circ c_{\mathcal A}=c_{\mathcal B}\circ\varphi_y$, and $(f^{-1}\varphi)_x$ is injective by (a) since $c_{\mathcal A},c_{\mathcal B}$ are bijective. (c) If $s,t\in(f^{-1}\mathcal A)(U)$ and $(f^{-1}\varphi)_U(s)=(f^{-1}\varphi)_U(t)$, then for every $x\in U$, $(f^{-1}\varphi)_x(s_x)=(f^{-1}\varphi)_x(t_x)$, so $s_x=t_x$ by (b), and $s=t$ by [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-sections-determined-by-germs]. Applied to $\varphi=e$ of Step 3: $f^{-1}e:f^{-1}\mathcal G\to f^{-1}\mathcal P$ is injective on sections over every open of $X$.

Detail written by the agent.

proof.text: *Step 5 ($f^{-1}$ commutes with the finite product).* $\mathcal P=\prod_{y\in Y}\mathcal A_y$ is a product of finitely many sheaves of sets on $Y$ computed sectionwise, with projections $p_y$. By [lem-weil-pbc-sets-inverse-image-colimits-finite-products] (b) the morphism $\pi:f^{-1}\mathcal P\to\prod_{y\in Y}f^{-1}\mathcal A_y$ with components $f^{-1}p_y$ is an isomorphism of sheaves of sets on $X$ (product computed sectionwise), hence bijective on sections over every open of $X$.

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAL (label lemma-constructible-in-constant, line 3133), the reduction step; Sheaves, Lemma Tag 008K (lemma-f-map) and the exactness of f^{-1}. Detail written by the agent.

proof.text: *Step 6 (pull-back of the constant sheaves on closed subsets; the reduction of 0CAL).* For $y\in Y$ let $Z_y=f^{-1}(W_y)$, a closed subset of $X$ since $f$ is continuous and $W_y$ is closed. By [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-closed-pushforward-constant] (applied to $f$, the closed subset $W_y\subseteq Y$ and the set $R_y$) the canonical morphism $\alpha^{y\flat}:f^{-1}\mathcal A_y=f^{-1}((i_{W_y})_*\underline{R_y}_{W_y})\to(i_{Z_y})_*\underline{R_y}_{Z_y}$ is an isomorphism of sheaves of sets on $X$, where $(i_{Z_y})_*\underline{R_y}_{Z_y}(U)=\{$locally constant maps $U\cap Z_y\to R_y\}$. Hence $\prod_y\alpha^{y\flat}:\prod_yf^{-1}\mathcal A_y\to\prod_y(i_{Z_y})_*\underline{R_y}_{Z_y}$ (sectionwise products) is bijective on sections over every open of $X$.

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAL (label lemma-constructible-in-constant, line 3133), the reduction step 'By Lemma 0CAK we reduce to the case of a finite sober topological space'. Detail written by the agent.

proof.text: *Step 7 (the $Z_y$ are constructible).* Let $y\in Y$. The set $Y\setminus W_y$ is open in $Y$, and quasi-compact because $Y$ is finite. By the property of $f$ in Step 1, $f^{-1}(Y\setminus W_y)=X\setminus Z_y$ is a quasi-compact open subset of $X$. The space $X$ is spectral [def-weil-spectral-space], so quasi-compact, and by [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-open-retrocompact-iff-quasi-compact] the quasi-compact opens $X$ and $X\setminus Z_y$ are retrocompact in $X$. Thus $Z_y=X\cap(X\setminus(X\setminus Z_y))$ has the form $U\cap(X\setminus V)$ with $U,V\subseteq X$ retrocompact open, so $Z_y$ is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]; it is closed by Step 6.

source.place: Modules, statement of Lemma Tag 0CAL ('constructible closed subsets'); the constructibility of the preimages is not written in the proof. Detail written by the agent.

proof.text: *Step 8 (conclusion).* Enumerate $Y=\{y_1,\dots,y_k\}$ ($k=|Y|\ge0$) and put $Z_l=Z_{y_l}$, $R_l=R_{y_l}=\mathcal G_{y_l}$, finite by Step 1; the $Z_l$ are constructible closed subsets of $X$ by Steps 6 and 7. The composite $\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\psi^{-1}}f^{-1}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{f^{-1}e}f^{-1}\mathcal P\xrightarrow{\pi}\prod_{l=1}^kf^{-1}\mathcal A_{y_l}\xrightarrow{\prod\alpha^{y_l\flat}}\prod_{l=1}^k(i_{Z_l})_*\underline{R_l}_{Z_l}$ is a morphism of sheaves of sets on $X$. Over every open $U\subseteq X$ each factor is injective on sections: $\psi^{-1}$ is an isomorphism (Step 1), $f^{-1}e$ by Step 4, $\pi$ by Step 5, $\prod\alpha^{y_l\flat}$ by Step 6. So the composite is injective on sections over every open of $X$, which is the assertion.

lean.statement: theorem spectral_finite_coequalizer_embeds_constant (X : TopCat.{u}) [SpectralSpace X] (F : X.Sheaf (Type u)) (m n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Opens X) (V : Fin m → Opens X) (S : Fin n → Type u) (T : Fin m → Type u) (hU : ∀ a : Fin n, IsCompact (U a : Set X)) (hV : ∀ b : Fin m, IsCompact (V b : Set X)) (hS : ∀ a : Fin n, Finite (S a)) (hT : ∀ b : Fin m, Finite (T b)) (A : Cofan (fun a : Fin n => extensionByEmptyConstant (U a) (S a))) (B : Cofan (fun b : Fin m => extensionByEmptyConstant (V b) (T b))) (hA : Nonempty (IsColimit A)) (hB : Nonempty (IsColimit B)) (β γ : B.pt ⟶ A.pt) (q : A.pt ⟶ F) (hq : β ≫ q = γ ≫ q) (hcoeq : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofork.ofπ q hq))) : ∃ (k : ℕ) (Z : Fin k → Set X) (R : Fin k → Type u), (∀ l : Fin k, IsClosed (Z l) ∧ Topology.IsConstructible (Z l) ∧ Finite (R l)) ∧ ∃ e : ∀ W : Opens X, F.obj.obj (op W) → ((l : Fin k) → LocallyConstant {x : X // x ∈ W ∧ x ∈ Z l} (R l)), (∀ W : Opens X, Function.Injective (e W)) ∧ ∀ (W W' : Opens X) (i : W' ⟶ W) (s : F.obj.obj (op W)) (l : Fin k), e W' (F.obj.map i.op s) l = LocallyConstant.comap ⟨fun x : {x : X // x ∈ W' ∧ x ∈ Z l} ↦ ⟨x.1, i.le x.2.1, x.2.2⟩, continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _⟩ (e W s l)
